variantLegend.2: instrumented isolated official two-frame gate, including its 100ms fallback
variantLegend.3: actual uninstrumented candidate build, no post-decode frames or timer

method.cold: New browser context, no display neighbor slots; normal initial three selections use cold resource loads. Later returns and rapid steps reuse DOM/cache.
method.warm: Display-neighbor radius 1, slots 2, settle 0; await display-ready targets before next normal selection. Initial open remains cold.
method.network: In-memory HTTP media server; main response starts after 40ms, 128KiB every 4ms; thumbnails immediate; Cache-Control 3600.
method.ready: MutationObserver confirms current image complete, positive natural dimensions, current layer opacity 1, underlay absent/opacity 0, no outgoing and no loader. Does not prove physical presentation.
method.timing: No screen capture or frame-marker clock. Single-variable diagnostic decode/reveal events for variants 0/1/2; common wrapped bitmap Promise completion in verification only.
method.capture: CDP PNG screencast everyNthFrame 1, immediate acknowledgement; 24-bit animated marker carries rAF ordinal, current index, readiness and action. Changes scheduling; excluded from timing comparison.
method.pixels: Exclude top 8 marker rows; compare phase-2 current image to settled reference of same input; flag RGB MAE > 1 or fraction with max channel difference > 16 greater than 0.005. Small defects may escape.

initialStudy.limitation: No equal paint dwell after DOM-ready; next selection can absorb rendering cost. Total latency is non-monotonic across variants; not evidence of universal speedup.

candidateVerification.limitation: 3 timing repetitions per profile and variant. Warm fast paths skip fresh decode gate. Some rapid intermediate/final actions have no independently identified captured sharp frame; DOM final state is ready.

nativeWKWebView.environment: installed macOS arm64 X Archive, official right-image-preview 0.10.1
nativeWKWebView.intervention: temporary in-memory callback proxy matches only the two exact callback bodies submitted by scheduleRevealAfterDecode; mode 0 schedules the frame chain in a microtask, mode 1 executes its second callback during the first native frame, mode 2 delegates both native frames. Bitmap/decode, other RAF calls, image/probe/layer logic, deadlines and production files remain unchanged.
nativeWKWebView.sample: One warm 3072x4096 JPEG; three remounts per mode in balanced order. No cold or physical-pixel capture.
nativeWKWebView.counterCheck: Each included run matched the target first and second callback exactly once. Independent VM check against the actual bundled helper revealed before/after simulated frames as 0:[1,1,1],1:[0,1,1],2:[0,0,1]; ordinary RAF unchanged.
nativeWKWebView.limitation: 4 exposed DOM samples per visit, 36 total; observer adds native frame callbacks. No pixel evidence. Mode zero uses microtasks, not synchronous source rewrite.

limits: CDP screencast is not a lossless recording of every physical presentation; marker gaps are retained.
One-frame black / 16px left-strip calibration caught 8 of 8 pulses, but does not establish lossless capture.
No independent reproduction demonstrating a benefit from retaining the two-frame gate.
No standalone Safari, Windows, Linux or constrained GPU validation.
Local scripts and PNGs are temporary, not published package content. No fixture media or private source paths are included here.
